Announcement titles describe removal of specific trading pairs—not necessarily full token delisting or loss of borrowing—so I won’t assume those constraints are confirmed.

I’ve reviewed all 261 quiet coins, the 96-hour paths for all 78 watchlist names, and detailed history for 33 finalists. The ranking favors potential multi-day funding depth, rather than just proximity to the -0.10% threshold; probabilities remain below 50% for every pick.

A data caveat: some episode summaries omit large episodes visible in the daily history. I used those daily observations as well, without treating historical extremes as the expected outcome. Spot borrow availability and cost are not provided, so arbitrage constraints are inferred from liquidity and past funding behavior, not confirmed.
